content: For a valid pair of SYNC and FUP messages a new Time Tuple, consisting of the Global Time value and the associated value of the Virtual Local Time, shall be calculated and forwarded to the StbM module via StbM_ Bus SetGlobalTime () ( according to 9.2 ) .

For a valid pair of SYNC and FUP messages with success- fully validated set of values SyncTimeSec , OVS and SyncTimeNSec a new Syn- clocal Time Tuple [TL Sync ;T3 VLT ] (refer to [5]), consisting of the Global Time value and the associated value of the Virtual Local Time, shall be calculated (refer to [SWS_CanTSyn_00146], [SWS_CanTSyn_00147], [SWS_CanTSyn_00148]) and for- warded to the StbM module via StbM_BusSetGlobalTime .
